تستجنسوا (form X)
# تَسْتَجْنِسُوا (tastajnisū) /tas.tad͡ʒ.ni.suː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجْنَسَ (istajnasa)
# تُسْتَجْنَسُوا (tustajnasū) /tus.tad͡ʒ.na.suː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجْنَسَ (istajnasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
